examples.text: If you control an Elf, draw two cards.
If it's your turn, draw three cards.
If you control two or more artifacts, target player draws two cards.
If there are seven or more cards in your graveyard, draw a card.

counterExamples: If you control an Elf, draw two cards instead.
If you would draw a card, draw four cards instead.
Unless you control an Elf, draw two cards.
If you control an Elf, you may draw two cards unless it is blue.
